_README: HAND-EDITABLE FILE. REPLAY DESK prints these on the event tape when replay time passes `date` + `time`.
Edit, correct or add entries freely; the app re-reads this file on every page load. Keep it valid JSON.
date: YYYY-MM-DD and time: HH:MM are Chicago wall-clock time (America/Chicago, CT).
type: EIA | EIA-NG | API | HORMUZ | MACRO | OTHER.  pause: true makes the replay auto-pause when the time hits (EIA and API by default).
products: which products the item is shown for (omit or [] = all).

time_precision: 'exact' = scheduled release time; 'approx' = the story broke around then (wire time not verified). Items timestamped before 07:00 CT print at the session open; items after 14:30 CT print at the NEXT session's open as 'since prior close'.

EIA scheduled times and inventory figures were checked against eia.gov (WPSR schedule page and the weekly stock series, release dates 10/28/2026 and 11/4/2026; natural gas storage released 10/29 and 11/5). API figures are not recorded here: the API report is a paid/press release and the numbers could not be verified, so only the scheduled time is listed; add the figures yourself if you have them.

Hormuz/geopolitical items are summarized from news coverage found at build time (sources listed per item). Wire timestamps were not available, so they are marked approx. Correct the times if you know them.
The trading engine never reads prices from this file. Prices come only from the bar files in /data.
